text.p: Results and close of play scores on the second day of four-day English county championship cricket matches on Friday:
At Chester-le-Street: Leicestershire beat Durham by an innings and 251 runs. Durham 126 (P.Simmons 6-14) and 139 (A.Mullally 5-27, V.Wells 4-44). Leicestershire 24 points, Durham 2.

At Scarborough: Yorkshire beat Nottinghamshire by an innings and six runs. Nottinghamshire 187 and 117 (D.Gough 6-36), Yorkshire 310 (A.McGrath 63, D.Byas 56, C.Cairns 6-110). Yorkshire 23 points, Nottinghamshire 4.
At Derby: Derbyshire 242 and 189-6 (T.O'Gorman 66), Warwickshire 231 (N.Knight 54; P.DeFreitas 7-101)
At Northampton: Lancashire 356 (J.Gallian 113; K.Innes 4-61, J.Taylor 4-73). Northamptonshire 357-5 (M.Loye 90, K.Curran 85 not out, T.Walton 52)
At Worcester: Gloucestershire 334 (M.Alleyne 149, M.Lynch 70; T.Moody 6-67). Worcestershire 313-8 (D.Leatherdale 66 not out, G.Hick 54; C.Walsh 5-62)
At Uxbridge: Somerset 485 (P.Holloway 168, R.Turner 75, K.Parsons 72), Middlesex 113-2 (P.Weekes 51 not out)
At Cardiff: Glamorgan 364 (A.Dale 90, M.Maynard 82), Surrey 273-4 (G.Thorpe 77, N.Shahid 66 not out).
At Canterbury: Kent 445 (N.Llong 130, C.Hooper 84, T.Ward 79, M.Ealham 74; J.Stephenson 5-104, D.Mascarenhas 4-101). Hampshire 249-5 (J.Laney 105, R.Smith 60)
At Chelmsford: Sussex 363 (A.Wells 122, I.Salisbury 70, N.Lenham 55) and 2-0, Essex 360 (G.Gooch 82, S.Law 64; R.Kirtley 4-94).
